verdict.rationale: Check publishes its own Postman collection guide that walks through creating companies, workplaces, employees, and payrolls. It also documents a sandbox for experimenting with API calls, and a /reference section exists, so first-party runnable examples are available. However, nothing shows the API reference itself is interactive (e.g., an in-browser "try it" console), and running the examples depends on Postman as an external tool. missing for 10: an evidenced in-browser interactive API explorer, runnable code samples embedded in the reference pages, independent or hands-on corroboration.
